title: Third-party scorer module allow-list is matched exactly, never by package prefix
answers: why does loading a RAGAS or DeepEval scorer reject a submodule path
third-party scorer module not in the allow-list after prefix change
can a file under an mlflow scorer package path be imported when deserializing
how do I add a new scorer module for trulens, phoenix, ragas or deepeval deserialization
body:
Invariant: a third_party_scorer_data.module is accepted only if it equals one of the names in THIRD_PARTY_SCORER_ALLOWED_MODULES. Dotted descendants of a package root (e.g. mlflow.genai.scorers.trulens.<run_id>.artifacts.payload) are rejected.
Enforced by: mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py:Scorer.model_validate runs `module_path not in THIRD_PARTY_SCORER_ALLOWED_MODULES` before importlib.import_module.
What breaks if skipped: a caller-placed file below an allow-listed package (e.g. a run artifact under a file:// experiment artifact root) gets imported and its top-level code runs before the class checks.
Constraints: the set in mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py:THIRD_PARTY_SCORER_ALLOWED_MODULES lists the modules that define supported scorer classes, so a new scorer module needs an entry there. Packages that define no Scorer subclass (e.g. mlflow.genai.scorers.trulens.scorers) are not allowed.
Applies: any change to third-party scorer deserialization or to the scorer packages under mlflow/genai/scorers (ragas, deepeval, trulens, phoenix).
applies: Deserialization of third-party scorers in mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py; not the server-side payload checks in mlflow/server/handlers.py.
says: Loading saved evaluation metrics rejects nested package paths for external scorers.
Saved model evaluation fails to load scorers using custom subpackage paths.
Allow new third-party evaluation scoring modules to be loaded from saved experiments.
Support restoring evaluation metrics defined inside external scoring framework submodules.
Evaluation runs fail when loading saved metrics from TruLens or Phoenix integrations.
search: Third-party scorer deserialization in mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py enforces that third_party_scorer_data.module exactly matches an entry in mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py:THIRD_PARTY_SCORER_ALLOWED_MODULES before import. In Scorer.model_validate, dotted descendants of package roots are rejected to prevent executing top-level code from caller-placed files under an experiment artifact root. New scorer modules for ragas, deepeval, trulens, or phoenix must be explicitly added to THIRD_PARTY_SCORER_ALLOWED_MODULES, but packages without a Scorer subclass are not permitted. This rule applies to deserialization under mlflow/genai/scorers tested in test_third_party_scorer_allow_list_is_exactly_the_scorer_defining_modules, but not to server-side checks in mlflow/server/handlers.py.
